{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Southern Natural Gas (SNG) Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline.<ref name=source1>[http://bit.ly/2kjZgVD Southern Natural Gas (SNG) Pipeline,] Wikipedia, accessed January 2018</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from natural gas supply basins in Texas, Louisiana, Mississippi, Alabama and the Gulf of Mexico to markets in Louisiana, Mississippi, Alabama, Florida, Georgia, South Carolina and Tennessee.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/southern-company-kinder-morgan-enter-southern-natural-gas-pipeline-strategic-venture-300296288.html|title=Southern Company, Kinder Morgan enter Southern Natural Gas pipeline strategic venture|last=|first=|date=10 July, 2016|website=PR Newswire|url-status=live|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=30 August, 2023}}</ref>

=== Cypress Pipeline Project ===
The pipeline runs from Elba Island, Chatham County, Georgia to Florida Gas Transmission interconnection, Clay County, Florida.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2005-07-14/pdf/E5-3727.pdf|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Owner: '''Southern Natural Gas Co LLC
*'''Capacity: '''500 MMcf/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2005-07-14/pdf/E5-3727.pdf|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''176.43 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2005-07-14/pdf/E5-3727.pdf|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''24, 30 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2005-07-14/pdf/E5-3727.pdf|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Proposal year: '''2005<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2005-07-14/pdf/E5-3727.pdf|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Start year: '''2007<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2005-07-14/pdf/E5-3727.pdf|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Background==
The Southern Natural Gas Pipeline system is operated by Kinder Morgan Energy Partners, and owned by Kinder Morgan (50%) and Southern Company (50%).<ref name=":0" />
